unresolved_gaps: No evidence establishes Anthropic's willingness to sell to SpaceX or an attainable acquisition price on February 3.
The proposed financing valuation and the xAI acquisition valuation measure different transactions.
No numerical threshold establishes what Marcus meant by not that much more.
No comparable comprehensive adoption measurement establishes the claimed breadth across consumer and enterprise markets.
The documented controversies do not provide a consistent comparison of their scale, seriousness or public reach.
